title: ilysanthes monticola
intro: Ilysanthes monticola, commonly known as the Montane Ilysanthes or Blue Mountain Ilysanthes, is a species of flowering plant in the family Acanthaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Ilysanthes monticola include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
